description: This line plot, titled “Finetuning for different r, WikiHow,” illustrates how the ROUGE-1 metric varies across different values of the hyperparameter r on the WikiHow dataset, comparing four distinct fine-tuning methods: MBart + LoRA (red circles), T5 + AdaLoRA (green triangles), MBart + AdaLoRA (orange diamonds), and T5 + LoRA (purple squares). The horizontal axis, labeled “log r,” spans from 0 to 8 on a logarithmic scale, indicating the logarithm of the r value. The vertical axis, labeled “ROUGE-1,” ranges from 0 to 35 and represents the ROUGE-1 score, a metric for summarization quality. The red line (MBart + LoRA) starts at approximately 23.5 when log r is 0 and rises to about 28.5 before slightly declining to around 26.5. The green line (T5 + AdaLoRA) begins at approximately 23.5, increases steadily to about 36, and remains constant thereafter. The orange line (MBart + AdaLoRA) starts at approximately 12, rises sharply to about 32 near log r = 4, and then plateaus around 33. The purple line (T5 + LoRA) begins at approximately 12, drops to a minimum of about 5 at log r = 0.5, then rises sharply to about 26 before leveling off near 26.5.
